_instructions: Copy this file to backend/appsettings.json before running the backend locally.
Fill ConnectionStrings.DefaultConnection with your real SQL Server connection string.
FlightData.Provider is currently FlightSqlStoredProcedure. If the airport later provides REST API access, switch this to FlightRestApi and fill FlightData.RestApi.
Do not commit backend/appsettings.json because it can contain database credentials.
